# Krafla

> Krafla (formerly isa-lm; Kernels Retargeted Across Families of Legacy Architectures) is a dependency-free C11 inference runtime for Llama-style language models with INT8 (Q8_0) and INT4 (Q4_0) weights, for machines without a GPU. It runs on x86-64 from SSE2 up to AVX-512 VNNI and on ARM from 32-bit ARMv7 NEON up to i8mm and SVE; each build binds every operator at compile time to the kernel written for its instruction set. MIT license.

Key facts:

- On the same model (Qwen2.5 0.5B) and formats, Krafla decodes at least as fast as llama.cpp at every ISA level measured: 1.2–1.5× with AVX-512 VNNI, 1.0–2.3× with AVX2, 2.1–10× with SSE2 and SSE4.1, 1.04–1.7× on AArch64.
- Models: Llama 2/3/3.1/3.2, TinyLlama, SmolLM2, Mistral, Qwen2/2.5, Qwen3, Gemma 2 and Gemma 3, converted from Hugging Face safetensors; Hugging Face tokenizer.json files; chat mode.
- Results are bit-identical for any thread count and prompt batch size and are checked against a numpy reference.
- Converted models (Qwen2.5, Qwen3, SmolLM2, TinyLlama; Q4_0 and Q8_0 files, mixed files for all but SmolLM2, and tokenizers): https://huggingface.co/models?other=krafla
- Not supported: GPUs, K-quant formats, mixture-of-experts models, image input, Phi (partial rotary embeddings).

## Docs

- [FAQ](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JonPark0/krafla/main/docs/faq.md): CPUs without AVX, Raspberry Pi, comparison with llama.cpp, models, memory, limits
- [User guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JonPark0/krafla/main/docs/user-guide.md): building, converting models, CLI options, threads, limits
- [Comparison with llama.cpp](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JonPark0/krafla/main/docs/benchmarks.md): speed and perplexity per ISA level
- [Architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JonPark0/krafla/main/docs/architecture.md): compile-time kernel binding, CPU guard, packing, threading
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JonPark0/krafla/main/README.md): overview, quick start, status

## Optional

- [File formats](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JonPark0/krafla/main/docs/file-format.md): the .mlb model and .mlt tokenizer formats
- [Writing kernels](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JonPark0/krafla/main/docs/kernels.md): adding a kernel or an ISA
- [Testing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JonPark0/krafla/main/docs/testing.md): test layers and benchmarks
- [Releases](https://github.com/JonPark0/krafla/releases): prebuilt binaries for Linux (x86-64, AArch64, ARMv7) and Windows (x86-64)
